cohort: Term neonates weighing at least 2500 grams, born with an Apgar score less than 7, and admitted within 48 hours of life.
finding: Myocardial dysfunction was detected in 28.9% of term neonates with perinatal asphyxia, and severe asphyxia, patent ductus arteriosus, and delivery through cesarean section were identified as independent determinants.
mod_finding: Delivery through cesarean section was identified as an independent determinant of myocardial dysfunction (aOR 2.65).
